title.zh: 共同活动中的差别制造：多重决定下 but-for 与关系参与分离
title.en: Difference-making in joint activity: but-for and relational participation come apart under overdetermination

claim.zh: 在一个依存可观测量的过程中，配置之间的维持与断裂沿运行恰是 Becoming.Dependence 的维持与断裂，两者互斥。but-for 检验留在过程之内，并固定实际所取的动作：由某配置以某动作的一步断裂依存，而扣除某一方的部分后同一动作仍可取、且以它的每一步都维持依存，则这一方的部分造成了差别；扣除任何单独一方的部分、以同一动作仍有断裂之步，为多重决定，此时没有哪一方单独造成差别。不固定动作时，动作决定结果：由同一配置，唯一汲取者的部分在平静的动作下造成差别，在外来冲击下损失被多重决定。在 Pool 中，同一过程、同一水平，第一个汲取者取同样的量：另有一方汲取时，它的部分造成差别；另有两方汲取时损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别，而扣除两方的部分则维持依存，差别由共同活动造成。两次运行中，关系读法都把它计为消耗，一个什么也不取的形成不计为消耗。一个形成的各事件之间须分开整段与步层面的检验：在公地过程中每步汲取两个单位，条件被消耗；第一个事件那一步维持依存，对任何正长度的周期都不侵蚀；扣除任何一个事件的汲取，甚至扣除任何一步之前的全部汲取，条件仍被消耗，整段的结局由尾部决定；而在断裂之步，由同一配置不汲取则依存被维持，断裂事件造成那一次断裂的差别。逐步读法不追踪差别制造：在 Pool 中恰取更新量、其部分不造成差别的汲取者，在另一方造成的断裂之步侵蚀。检验在动作决定步骤（Determined）、且动作在扣除后的配置上可取时才合乎其意：把冲击写进同一动作的步骤关系，损失又被多重决定，虽然同一动作的平静结局会维持依存（Hidden）；动作在扣除后不可取，检验不判定任何一方（Tagged）。Pool 与 Shock 的过程都由动作决定步骤。动作决定步骤、在扣除后可取，并且依存在扣除后的配置上仍成立并被满足时，检验是二分的：或者那一部分造成差别，或者同一动作仍断裂依存；扣除本身使依存落空时（那一部分是支持者），检验不作判断。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: In a process with observables of dependence, keeping and breaking between configurations are, along a run, exactly those of Becoming.Dependence, and they are exclusive. The but-for test stays within the process and holds the move actually taken fixed: when the step from a configuration by a move breaks a dependence and, with one party's part withheld, the same move can still be taken and every step by it keeps the dependence, that party's part makes the difference; when withholding any single party's part still leaves a breaking step by the same move, the loss is overdetermined and no party alone makes the difference. Without the move held fixed, the move decides: from one configuration a lone drawer's part makes the difference under a calm move, while under an exogenous shock the loss is overdetermined. In Pool, in one process at one level with the first drawer taking the same amount: with one other drawer its part makes the difference; with two others the loss is overdetermined and its part makes none, while withholding two parts keeps the dependence, so the difference belongs to the joint activity. In both runs the relational reading counts it as consuming, and a formation that takes nothing is not. Across a formation's own events the run-level and step-level tests come apart: drawing two units at every step in the commons process consumes the condition; the first event's step keeps the dependence and undermines for no positive cycle; with any single event's draw withheld, indeed with every draw before any step withheld, the condition is still consumed, the run-level outcome being fixed by the tail; at the breaking step, drawing nothing from the same configuration keeps the dependence, so the breaking event makes the step-level difference. The stepwise reading does not track difference-making: in Pool a drawer taking exactly the renewal, whose part makes no difference, undermines at the break another causes. The test reads as intended when the move determines the step (Determined) and can be taken from the withheld configuration: with a shock written into the step relation of a single move, the loss is overdetermined again though the calm outcome of the same move would keep the dependence (Hidden); a move unavailable after withholding decides nothing (Tagged). The processes of Pool and Shock are determined by the move. When the move determines the step and is available after withholding, and the dependence still holds and is met at the withheld configuration, the test is a dichotomy: either the part makes the difference or the same move still breaks the dependence; when withholding the part itself leaves the dependence unmet (the part is a support), the test is silent. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 扣除（withhold）是外给的配置变换：只改动一方或一步的部分，过程本身给出由此到达的配置。扣除是否让其余不变，是每次应用的建模义务。检验固定实际所取的动作：动作属于其余的活动。它要求动作在扣除后的配置上可取，并在动作决定步骤（Determined）时才合乎其意，所以外来冲击须写进动作，不写进步骤关系。在 Pool 中下一步的水平不依赖动作，结论不受影响。
hypotheses.en: Withholding is a supplied map on configurations: it changes only one party's or one step's part, and the process gives the configurations reached from there. Whether withholding leaves the rest unchanged is a modelling duty of each application. The test holds the move actually taken fixed: the move belongs to the rest of the activity. It requires the move to be available from the withheld configuration and reads as intended when the move determines the step (Determined), so exogenous shocks belong in the move, not in the step relation. In Pool the next level does not depend on the move, so the conclusions are unaffected.

hypotheses.zh: 关系读法是 relational-reading-comparison 的整段读法，经 Web.ConsumingIn 读出。
hypotheses.en: The relational reading is the whole-run reading of relational-reading-comparison, read through Web.ConsumingIn.

hypotheses.zh: 整段层面的检验（扣除事件的汲取后条件是否仍被消耗）与 MakesDifference（扣除配置之中的部分后这一步是否维持依存）是不同的检验；公地过程中汲取是动作而不是配置的一部分，所以 depletion_is_joint 用的是前者。
hypotheses.en: The run-level test (whether the condition is still consumed with events' draws withheld) and MakesDifference (whether the step keeps the dependence with a part of the configuration withheld) are different tests; in the commons process the draw is the move, not part of the configuration, so depletion_is_joint uses the former.

correspondence.zh: but-for 检验与关系读法回答不同的问题：前者问扣除一方的部分是否改变结果，后者问一方实际参与了什么及该条件的去向。多重决定的情形正是“我的一份无关紧要”这一推理的形式。两者都不是因果理论，也不推出责任或义务。关于集体伤害与过度决定的哲学讨论（如 Parfit、Kagan，作者据先前知识，本次未新读）是对照。“but-for 不能代替参与”只对单一部分的、整段层面的检验证明；步层面的检验挑出断裂事件，NESS 一类检验是另外的对手。
correspondence.en: The but-for test and the relational reading answer different questions: whether withholding a party's part changes the outcome, and what a party actually took part in and where the condition went. The overdetermined case is the form of “my share makes no difference”. Neither is a causal theory, and neither yields responsibility or duty. Philosophical work on collective harm and overdetermination (for example Parfit and Kagan, from the author's prior knowledge, not newly read) is the comparison. That “but-for cannot replace participation” is shown only for the single-part, run-level test; the step-level test picks out the breaking event, and NESS-type tests are further rivals.

detail.zh: Keeps、Breaks 沿运行恰是 Web.Kept、Web.Broken（along_kept、along_broken）；Pool 的分类经 Dependence.along 读出。
detail.en: Keeps and Breaks along a run are exactly Web.Kept and Web.Broken (along_kept, along_broken); Pool's classification is read through Dependence.along.

output.zh: 依存可观测量、依存网及其维持、断裂与消耗。
output.en: Dependence observables, webs and their keeping, breaking and consumption.

input.zh: 配置之间的维持与断裂及 but-for 检验。
input.en: Keeping and breaking between configurations, and the but-for test.

detail.zh: depletion_is_joint 用 UnderminingFor 陈述第一个事件对任何周期都不侵蚀。
detail.en: depletion_is_joint uses UnderminingFor to state that the first event undermines for no cycle.

input.zh: 渐进耗竭中事件的读法。
input.en: The reading of events in gradual depletion.

detail.zh: 该结果的 jointly_consuming 表明联合消耗没有单一的消耗者；本结果表明多重决定下 but-for 不归属差别，而关系读法仍把每个汲取者计为消耗，承接其“差别制造归属”的下一步。
detail.en: That result's jointly_consuming shows joint consumption has no single consumer; this one shows that under overdetermination but-for attributes no difference while the relational reading still counts each drawer as consuming, taking up its next step on difference-making attribution.

detail.zh: 用单一部分的、整段层面的 but-for 差别制造代替参与，不能满足该结果所记录的 C 的排序；那些排序把 Ren 所采纳的问题形式化（整合文档 §8.5、§11、§12）。
detail.en: Replacing participation by single-part, run-level but-for difference-making cannot meet the C rankings recorded in that result, which formalize the problem Ren adopted (integration note §§8.5, 11, 12).

detail.zh: 逐步读法不追踪差别制造（Pool.within_share_undermines）；步层面的检验与逐步读法都扣下断裂事件，但逐步读法也扣下恰取更新量的汲取者。
detail.en: The stepwise reading does not track difference-making (Pool.within_share_undermines); the step-level test and the stepwise reading both withhold the breaking event, but the stepwise reading also withholds a drawer taking exactly the renewal.

detail.zh: 整段层面的结局由尾部决定（Commons.no_finite_segment_makes_difference），与视界结果是同一事实。
detail.en: The run-level outcome is fixed by the tail (Commons.no_finite_segment_makes_difference), the same fact as the horizon result.

detail.zh: 多重决定（Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint 的三方运行）：每一方单独都不造成差别，共同活动造成了损失。在一个形成的各事件之间，整段层面没有哪个有限的事件集合造成差别（Commons.depletion_is_joint、Commons.no_finite_segment_makes_difference），而断裂事件造成步层面的差别（Commons.breaking_event_makes_step_difference；第二次独立审查 F7）。
detail.en: Overdetermination (the three-drawer run of Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint): no party alone makes the difference, while the joint activity makes the loss. Across a formation's own events no finite set of events makes the run-level difference (Commons.depletion_is_joint, Commons.no_finite_segment_makes_difference), while the breaking event makes the step-level difference (Commons.breaking_event_makes_step_difference; second independent review F7).

detail.zh: 不固定动作时动作决定结果（Shock.move_decides）：由同一配置，唯一汲取者的部分在平静的动作下造成差别，在外来冲击下损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别（第二次独立审查 F6）。
detail.en: Without the move held fixed, the move decides (Shock.move_decides): from one configuration a lone drawer's part makes the difference under the calm move, and under an exogenous shock the loss is overdetermined and its part makes none (second independent review F6).

detail.zh: 第二次独立审查：P7 的数学接受；侵蚀与 but-for 的定义须修正（已修正）；散文七处强于 Lean，§8.5 的表在 (a)(b) 与 but-for 一栏上不公允（已更正，整合文档 §11）。
detail.en: Second independent review: the mathematics of P7 is accepted; the definitions of undermining and but-for needed repair (repaired); the prose overclaimed in seven places and the §8.5 table was unfair in rows (a), (b) and the but-for column (corrected, integration note §11).

detail.zh: 把冲击写进步骤关系，检验又失去意义（Hidden.shock_in_the_step）：同一动作的一步可以更新并汲取，也可以清空条件；动作不决定步骤，唯一汲取者的损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别，虽然由扣除后的配置，同一动作的平静结局维持依存（第三次独立审查 G6）。
detail.en: With the shock written into the step relation the test loses its meaning again (Hidden.shock_in_the_step): one move's step can renew and take or empty the condition; the move does not determine the step, the lone drawer's loss is overdetermined and its part makes no difference, though from the withheld configuration the calm outcome of the same move keeps the dependence (third independent review G6).

detail.zh: 动作在扣除后不可取时（Tagged.move_unavailable）：每个动作指名它所取自的配置，动作决定步骤并断裂依存，但扣除任何汲取者的部分后都不能取；没有“动作可取”一项时，每个汲取者的部分都会空洞地造成差别；有了它，没有哪一方造成差别，损失也不是多重决定的，而在 Pool.process 中由同一配置它是（第三次独立审查 G6）。
detail.en: When the move is unavailable after withholding (Tagged.move_unavailable): each move names the configuration it is taken from; the move determines the step and breaks the dependence, but no withheld configuration can take it; without the clause that the move can be taken, every drawer's part would make the difference vacuously; with it none does, and the loss is not overdetermined either, while under Pool.process from the same configuration it is (third independent review G6).

detail.zh: 第三次独立审查：P8、P9 与 P7b 的全部声明接受，公理报告为空；MetSince 须比较那一步的所需（已修正），依存中断一步即开始新的一段（已披露），but-for 须动作可取（已修正）；散文在逐步读法的代价、节制、替代、交互与剩余的免费连通上强于 Lean（已更正，整合文档 §12）。
detail.en: Third independent review: every P8, P9 and P7b declaration is accepted with empty axiom reports; MetSince had to compare the need at that step (repaired), a one-step lapse starts a new tenure (disclosed), and but-for needs the move to be available (repaired); the prose overclaimed on the stepwise cost, restraint, substitution, interaction and the residual free connection (corrected, integration note §12).

limitations.zh: 不提出因果理论；更精细的归属（NESS 检验、结构方程中的实际因果）未加入。不推出责任、义务或排序。Pool、Shock 与 depleting 是最小见证；检验固定动作，应用若有外来冲击，须把它写进动作，不写进步骤关系（Hidden）。
limitations.en: Proposes no causal theory; finer attribution (the NESS test, actual causation in structural equations) is not added. Yields no responsibility, duty or ranking. Pool, Shock and depleting are minimal witnesses; the test holds the move fixed, and an application with exogenous shocks must write them into the move, not into the step relation (Hidden).

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261009T143148.368990Z）：Becoming.Joint 21 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 27 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 1061 项定理／1716 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致。作者反审见整合文档 §8.6；另一 agent（Claude Opus 5.5，未参与撰写）作了独立审查（BECOMING-P7-REVIEW.md），其更正在整合文档 §11 处理；第三次独立审查（BECOMING-P8-P9-P7B-REVIEW.md）指出 but-for 须动作可取并由动作决定步骤，更正在 §12；第四次独立审查（BECOMING-P9B-P10-P11-REVIEW.md）指出二分还需依存在扣除后仍成立并被满足，更正在 §15。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 29 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261009T143148.368990Z): all 21 theorems of Becoming.Joint have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 27 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 1061 theorems/1716 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The author's counterreview is in §8.6 of the integration note; a separate agent (Claude Opus 5.5, not an author) reviewed it independently (BECOMING-P7-REVIEW.md), and its corrections are handled in §11; a third independent review (BECOMING-P8-P9-P7B-REVIEW.md) found that but-for needs the move to be available and to determine the step, corrected in §12; a fourth (BECOMING-P9B-P10-P11-REVIEW.md) found that the dichotomy also needs the dependence to hold and be met at the withheld configuration, corrected in §15. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 29 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: 加入更精细的归属作为另一种读法，并与关系读法比较；说明在多重决定下，“这一共同活动是消耗”的判断怎样到达各参与者。
next_delta.en: Add finer attribution as another reading and compare it with the relational reading; explain how, under overdetermination, the judgment that a joint activity consumes reaches each participant.
